cohort: 290 women with twin pregnancies who underwent induction of labor
finding: Labor induction in both dichorionic and monochorionic uncomplicated twin pregnancies resulted in excellent vaginal delivery rates, but monochorionic twins had higher rates of neonatal adverse outcomes, likely due to earlier gestational age at delivery.
gest_age: Dichorionic twins: 38.00 weeks, Monochorionic twins: 36.43 weeks
